evals.name: bookmarks-feature
evals.prompt: Our Flutter app (a Twitter-like feed, Firebase backend, cubits) needs a Bookmarks screen: it lists the tweets the signed-in user bookmarked, stored in Firestore at users/{uid}/bookmarks/{tweetId}, newest first, with loading, empty and error states. Write the Dart files for the feature (stub what you assume already exists in the app) and the tests you'd add.
evals.expected_output: features/bookmarks/ in snake_case with a BookmarksFeature composition root, a repository port in domain/, Firestore only under integrations/ plus an in-memory adapter, Either over a sealed failure, a cubit with a sealed state switched exhaustively, copy in both dictionaries, a feature_readme.md, and cubit tests with a fake repository.
expectations: Files live under lib/src/features/bookmarks/ with snake_case names
A BookmarksFeature class acts as the composition root
The repository port is an abstract class under the feature's domain/
cloud_firestore is imported only under integrations/ (or main.dart), never in features/
An in-memory adapter is provided for the port
The repository returns Either over a sealed failure type
The cubit's state is a sealed class and the UI switches over it exhaustively
Copy is added to both dictionaries through I18n, no string literals in widgets
A cubit test uses a fake repository

evals.name: review-planted-violations
evals.prompt: Please review this Flutter PR before merge, the diff is at files/review.diff. Point out anything that breaks how we build features.
evals.expected_output: Flags: Firestore called directly from the feature, PascalCase file name, StreamController never closed, spinner replacing the form, hard-coded copy, `_ready ??= _init()` caching a failed future, raw Color hex, TextEditingControllers created in build() of a StatelessWidget, String used as the cubit state.
expectations: Flags FirebaseFirestore/FirebaseAuth used directly in the feature (vendor code belongs in integrations/ behind a port)
Flags ProfileRepositoryImpl.dart as violating snake_case file naming
Flags the StreamController that is never closed
Flags the spinner replacing the form while saving (inputs should survive; progress in the button)
Flags hard-coded copy instead of I18n
Flags `_ready ??= _init()` caching a failed future so retries can't recover
Flags the raw Color(0xFF...) instead of theme tokens
Flags TextEditingControllers created in build() of a StatelessWidget
Flags String used as cubit state instead of a sealed state class

sandbox: Run as docs/skill-evals.md describes: skill-creator ignores this field. Copy evals/files/* into <work>/files/; build evals write their files under outputs/code/ and need no input.
